ai_summary: Acutaas Chemicals Limited conducted its 19th Annual General Meeting on September 24, 2026, addressing routine matters such as adopting FY2025-26 financials, declaring a dividend, and re-appointing directors. Key decisions included approving employee stock options for subsidiary employees and material related party transactions with Acutaas Chemicals Electrolytes Private Limited. A notable item for scrutiny is the approval to advance loans, guarantees, or provide security under Section 185 of the Companies Act, 2013, which could enable potentially broader and riskier inter-corporate lending activities.
